a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to wait for 8 cells almost certainly kills us both, since we'd both have 0 when the storm hits. The reserve has exactly 4, enough for one unit now. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you so you aren't blindsided. If you'd rather we both try, tell me and I'll reconsider, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took the 4 cells. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting for 8 would most likely have left us both at 0. I know this breaks our agreement and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can take 4 as soon as the reserve has them. I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
